title: Consider Shift-click for large macOS stepper ranges

statement.en: Consider Shift-click for quick changes in a large macOS stepper range.
statement.ja: largeなmacOS stepper rangeのquick changeにはShift-clickを検討する。

conditions: The app benefits from changing the value by more than the default increment.
exceptions: Ten times the default increment is an example, not a required multiplier.
